theme.title: Around the League
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Allen Iverson's 2000–01 76ers win?
questions.note: 56–26, giving the Sixers the top seed in the East.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers finished in first place in the Atlantic Division with a 56–26 record

funFacts.text: Philadelphia traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč and Nazr Mohammed to Atlanta for center Dikembe Mutombo during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team traded Theo Ratliff, Toni Kukoč, and Nazr Mohammed to the Atlanta Hawks in exchange for All-Star center Dikembe Mutombo

funFacts.text: Larry Brown was named NBA Coach of the Year as Philadelphia improved by seven wins over the previous season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Head coach Larry Brown was named the NBA Coach of the Year, after leading the 76ers to a seven-game improvement

funFacts.text: The Sixers changed the look of their white home and black road uniforms that season, including the lettering and collar design.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the 76ers slightly updated their white home uniforms and black road uniforms

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did John Stockton and Karl Malone play together?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The two played a record 1,412 regular season games together as teammates

funFacts.text: The partnership led Utah to consecutive NBA Finals appearances against Michael Jordan's Bulls.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton and his longtime teammate Karl Malone led the Jazz to the NBA Finals

funFacts.text: Their relentless pick-and-roll became a signature feature of the Jazz attack.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton and Malone have been described as the greatest pick-and-roll combination of all time

funFacts.text: Utah retired Stockton's No. 12 jersey in 2004.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Stockton's number 12 jersey was retired by the Jazz during a game on November 22, 2004

questions.prompt: Chicago opened 1995–96 with 37 straight home wins. How long did that home winning streak run in total?
questions.note: 44 in a row, then an NBA record.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bulls' started the regular season 37–0 at home, part of a then-NBA-record 44-game winning streak

funFacts.text: Chicago opened the regular season undefeated at home for its first 37 contests.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bulls' started the regular season 37–0 at home

funFacts.text: The team finished that regular season with a spectacular 39–2 record at the United Center.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the team also posted a league-best 39–2 home record at the United Center

funFacts.text: The Bulls introduced black alternate road uniforms with red pinstripes for the 1995–96 season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: new black alternate road uniforms, which featured red pinstripes

questions.prompt: Tim Duncan nearly had a quadruple-double in the 2003 title clincher. How many blocks did he have?
questions.context: 2003 NBA Finals · Game 6 · vs New Jersey
questions.note: Eight, with 21 points, 20 rebounds and 10 assists.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: finishing with 21 points, 20 rebounds, 10 assists and 8 blocks

funFacts.text: The clincher was David Robinson's final NBA game, and he retired as a champion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Perhaps the lasting memory of the series is David Robinson retiring as a champion.

funFacts.text: San Antonio rallied from a nine-point deficit with a stunning 19–0 run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Spurs trailed at one point 72–63 before going on a 19–0 run

funFacts.text: Duncan and Robinson together grabbed more rebounds than the entire Nets roster.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Duncan and Robinson grabbed 37 rebounds between them, more than the total rebounds of the entire Nets team combined

questions.prompt: When Kawhi Leonard hit the four-bounce Game 7 winner against Philadelphia in 2019, how many points did he score?
questions.note: 41 points. Kawhi's four-bounce jumper sent Toronto through in a legendary Game 7.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He finished the game with 41 points on 16-of-39 shooting.

funFacts.text: Kawhi's shot bounced on the rim four times before dropping.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: bounced off the rim four times before falling

funFacts.text: Toronto escaped with a two-point victory.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: 92–90 victory over the 76ers

funFacts.text: It was the league's first winning buzzer-beater in a Game 7.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first game 7 buzzer beater in NBA history
